questions.q: What theory is the video about?
o: The theory of the invisible thread
The theory of the Big Bang
questions.e: In the video: "Jeste čuli za teoriju nevidljive žice?" — have you heard of the theory of the invisible thread?

o: We are connected to people long before we meet them
questions.e: In the video: "smo sa nekim ljudima povezani mnogo pre nego što uopšte znamo da oni postoje" — we are connected with some people long before we even know they exist.

questions.q: Where might the person who will become the most important one be sitting?
o: In a café where you have never been
questions.e: In the video: "sedi u nekom kafiću u kom ti nikada nisi ni bio" — sitting in some café where you've never been.

o: The most ordinary decision — to go or travel somewhere
A call from an unknown number
questions.e: In the video: "jedna obična odluka, recimo da odeš negde, da izađeš tamo, da otputuješ negde, da tu žicu poveže" — one ordinary decision, say to go somewhere, to go out there, to travel somewhere, can connect that thread.

questions.q: What does the author advise not to think?
o: That we have already seen everything in life
questions.e: In the video: "Nemojmo misliti da smo već sve videli od života" — let's not think that we have already seen everything life has to offer.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Već si je sreo i *mimoišli* ste se.
questions.e: Mimoići se — to miss each other, to pass by one another.
Naizgled — at first glance; izgled — appearance.
U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u kafiću.

questions.q: Tvoj budući najbolji prijatelj živi u nekoj drugoj ___.
Jeste li čuli za ___ nevidljive žice?
questions.e: Čuti za someone/something — accusative case: za teoriju.
Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa ljudima.
